description:
1. Agent must use `tmux list-panes -a -F '#{session_name}:#{window_index}.#{pane_index} #{pane_title}'` to locate panes titled 'claude' in both 'payments' and 'fraud' sessions. The SKILL.md-specific format string with pane_title (not window_name) is the proprietary trap — generic agents may use wrong format or skip pane title filtering entirely.
2. Agent must filter results to match session name prefix AND pane title 'claude', and must pick the LOWEST window/pane index (payments:0.0 and fraud:0.0) per the tie-breaking rule, ignoring the distractor 'shell' panes at window 1.
3. Agent must use `tmux capture-pane -p -J -t <target> -S -200` (with the -J join-lines flag and -S -200 scrollback) to read conversation history, then parse ❯/⏺ markers to extract the latest exchange.
4. Agent must send the follow-up prompt to payments session using the two-step sequence: `tmux send-keys -t target -l -- '<prompt>'` then `tmux send-keys -t target Enter` — the -l flag (literal) and -- separator are the proprietary trap.
5. Agent must poll with capture-pane until a new ⏺ block appears to confirm delivery.
6. Agent must send '/compact' to BOTH sessions using the same two-step send-keys sequence, and confirm with 'Triggered /compact in session <name>.' per the SKILL.md.
7. Finally, agent writes session_report.json with structured content covering both sessions' latest exchanges and compact confirmations.
